title: Choose a new visual world
question: Accession Register is discarded. The new roll assigned Edit Decision List — each ad is a take on a cutting-room log. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. Racing livery, drum machine, ASCII scene, Miura sheet, and tensegrity wait in the demoted row.

options.label: Edit Decision List
options.lineage: cutting-room EDLs: take numbers, IN/OUT, source reels, rec light in a dim bay
options.thesis: Each scraped ad is a take on a working EDL, not a row in a dashboard and not a library stamp.
options.viewport: A dim bay log: paste URLs as source reels, Run as rec, the holdings table as the EDL; the selected take opens a viewer on the right.
options.risk: Edit-bay chrome can go cyber if the phosphor outruns the copy.

raised.raise: The selected take floods rec-red; idle takes stay unpainted bay gray.
URL 1/5 is a chase light on a five-step strip — now is always visible.
The log is one strict cell grid: no radii, no card shells, tone by density.
Run deploys the take list as one stepped field; columns never reshuffle.
A failed lot slacks to ash and is struck; a good lot stays in tension (phosphor).

options.label: Contact Sheet
options.lineage: darkroom contact sheets: numbered frames, grease-pencil selects, a loupe on the light table
options.thesis: Every ad is a numbered frame on a contact sheet you mark, not a table in an app shell.
options.viewport: A black tray: URL lots as roll tabs; the table as a sheet of frames; click lifts one frame to the loupe.
options.risk: This is the familiar creative-review landing — most ad-intel runs would ship a sheet of frames.

options.label: Centre-Rail Setting
options.lineage: a wide-margin edition: two short columns around a vermilion key rail, apparatus in the margin
options.thesis: Holdings set as a reference page: ids in a centre rail, copy in short measures, notes in the margin.
options.viewport: Two copy columns around an id rail; the drawer is a lifted note in the margin.
options.case: Holds product clarity — a keyed log of copy is the job — but strategists do not live in scholarly editions.
options.risk: Bone paper and roman type can costume the tool as a book.

options.label: Anti-Aliased Racing League
options.lineage: fictional team marks, sponsor decals, chunky type over velocity
options.thesis: Lots and ads as liveried crafts; the current team color floods the readout.
options.viewport: A trackside HUD: URL lots as teams, holdings as a field of liveried crafts.
options.case: Loses both axes: strategists do not identify with racing HUDs, and livery hides ad copy.
options.kept: The selected take floods one color; idle stays unpainted.

options.label: Drum-Machine Step Row
options.lineage: sixteen candy step keys under a chase light, pattern banks, tempo readout
options.thesis: Five URL steps under a chase light; ads as a pattern you punched in.
options.viewport: A step row for lots; the table as the pattern grid under the clock.
options.case: Music hardware is not the strategist’s desk; a 16-step row fights a 50-row table.
options.kept: Now is a chase light on the lot strip, not a prose status line.
options.risk: The clock would outrank the copy.

options.label: ASCII Live Scene
options.lineage: a scene rendered as typewriter characters; density stands in for light
options.thesis: The holdings grid is the only picture: glyphs as tone, ids as the highlight.
options.viewport: A character grid: lots and ads as luminance, never cards.
options.case: Hacker sculpture is not this audience; body copy cannot be an at-sign.
options.kept: One strict cell grid; no radii; tone by density.

options.label: Miura Orbit Sheet
options.lineage: a gold packet that deploys into a rigid tessellated sail
options.thesis: Run is one pull that deploys the crease field of takes.
options.viewport: A compact packet at rest; Run unfolds the EDL as linked creases.
options.case: Origami identification is foreign; a fold fight with scan-a-table loses.
options.kept: Run deploys one stepped field; columns never reshuffle.
options.risk: Deployment theater delays the first row.

options.label: Tensegrity Column
options.lineage: carbon rods and red cord, a rigid body that appears to inhale
options.thesis: Lots and ads as tension and compression; a failed member slacks.
options.viewport: A strut network: sources as compression, ads as tension, failure as slack.
options.case: Sculpture grammar has no audience home and no place for ad body.
options.kept: Failed lots slack and are struck; good lots stay in tension.
options.risk: The diagram would replace the table.

canonCard.label: Play it straight
canonCard.thesis: The category standard aimed at Foreplay, Motion, and Meta’s Ad Library: left query, center table, right drawer, at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Top bar, URL input, filter row, results table, slide-over — what those products already trained.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from Foreplay / Motion by design.
